description: This file defines the ORM-mapped PHP class 'PerformanceTrackerLog' which represents log entries related to performance tracking within the OrangeHRM system. It contains properties for logging details, comments, status, achievement, timestamps, and relationships to other entities like PerformanceTracker, Employee, and User.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLog
classes.description: Entity class mapping to 'ohrm_performance_tracker_log' table, representing logs related to performance tracking with properties, constants, and ORM annotations for persistence.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the log entry.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the log entry.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Returns the log string.

methods.name: setLog
methods.description: Sets the log string.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the log.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment associated with the log.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the log.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the log.

methods.name: getAchievement
methods.description: Returns the achievement details.

methods.name: setAchievement
methods.description: Sets the achievement details.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the log was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the log was added.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the log was last modified.

methods.name: setModifiedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the log was last modified.

methods.name: getPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Returns the associated PerformanceTracker entity.

methods.name: setPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Associates a PerformanceTracker entity.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who is associated with this log.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User who made or is associated with this log.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User entity.
